mechanism: Posaconazole may increase vitamin K metabolism or reduce its absorption through CYP3A4 inhibition effects on warfarin metabolism, indirectly affecting anticoagulation efficacy when vitamin K is used as an antagonist reversal agent.
action: Monitor INR closely if vitamin K is administered concurrently with posaconazole in anticoagulated patients; adjust warfarin dosing as needed based on INR values.
